slides.title: Value of policy (𝑽𝝅)

visualInspection.notes: Finite undiscounted return sums T rewards from r_(t+1). Infinite discounted return uses powers gamma^(i−1), with 0≤gamma<1. Gamma=0 is immediate-only; closer to one retains distant weights. Bounded rewards plus discount give convergence; time limit is not the only reason for discounting. Actual readable 1800×1013 source pixels inspected alongside text.

slides.title: Exploration vs Exploitation

visualInspection.notes: Exploration gathers information; exploitation follows best current estimate. Source calls exploitation highest immediate reward, but Q values encode cumulative return. Excessive exploit can miss better actions; excessive explore sacrifices use of learned behavior, not a universal theorem of failure. Actual readable 1800×1013 source pixels inspected alongside text.
